# Third-party assets

This directory is reserved for third-party files that are actually distributed
with HPC Study.

Before adding a third-party asset, record:

- upstream project and exact source URL;
- copyright holder;
- exact license and version;
- whether modification is allowed;
- required attribution or NOTICE text;
- whether the file was modified.

Do not place reference-only vendor documentation, copied screenshots, manuals,
or diagrams here. Reference-only material belongs in `docs/SOURCES.md` and is
not redistributed with the project.

At present, HPC Study does not bundle third-party media assets in this
directory. three.js is loaded at runtime from a CDN and is documented in the
root `NOTICE.md`.
